scenes.title: YOU'RE NOT SITTING STILL
scenes.say: You think you're sitting still? Ask the Sun. It says you're doing a hundred thousand kilometers an hour.

scenes.title: Speed depends on who you ask
scenes.say: Ask your couch: zero. Earth's center: sixteen hundred, from the spin. The Sun: a hundred thousand. The galaxy: eight hundred thousand. The leftover Big Bang glow: over a million.

scenes.label: KM EVERY SECOND: THE SUN'S SPEED VS THE BIG BANG GLOW. YOU FEEL NOTHING
scenes.src: Planck 2018: 369.82 km/s vs the cosmic microwave background
scenes.say: Three hundred seventy kilometers every second, and you feel nothing. Steady speed has no feeling.

scenes.title: WHICH SPEED IS REAL?
scenes.say: So which speed is the real one? Comment couch, sun, or none.
